spec_match.rationale: Demonstrates §13.2's exact claim — display-p3-linear (like srgb-linear and XYZ) is linear in light intensity and suited to physical light mixing — using the shared color-interpolation-method production in gradients and color-mix().

interactive.rationale: Two color pickers and a mix-percentage slider drive four gradient strips and live color-mix() getComputedStyle readouts; every rendered comparison updates as the user interacts.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card promises a working srgb/srgb-linear proof plus a display-p3-linear pair that activates when supported, and the page delivers both, including the labelled unsupported state.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers the unsupported-branch (explicit labelled panel with the measured CSS.supports results, never a blank strip), serialization-in-mixing-space subtlety, and the floating-point residue visible in real srgb-linear readouts.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite includes color-mix and gradient interpolation assertions for display-p3-linear that fail honestly on Chromium 141 and are expected to pass from Chrome 144.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141: screenshots show the srgb strip's muddy middle versus the visibly brighter srgb-linear strip, DOM dumps show color(srgb 0.5 0.5 0) vs color(srgb-linear 0.5 0.5 2.79397e-9), console clean; the display-p3-linear supported branch could not be exercised without a 144+ build, and chrome-devtools-mcp was unavailable for control-driving.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts srgb-linear-pair-live (the working half) and p3-linear-branch-labelled with the measured support booleans, so production telemetry distinguishes the two branches.

design_system.rationale: UI chrome on CSS variables, button override rule respected, range slider accent-color from a variable; gradient/chip colors are the tested values themselves and exempt.

accessibility.rationale: Native labelled color/range inputs, strips exposed as role=img with descriptive labels, and an aria-live readout giving numeric equivalents for the visual difference; partial because the accessibility tree could not be inspected without chrome-devtools-mcp.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified at a true 360px CSS viewport and 1280px desktop after fixing a real bug found in review (the hidden color-mix row leaked because an author display:grid beat the UA [hidden] rule); no horizontal overflow, controls stack, 44px targets.

openQuestions.title: Verify the display-p3-linear strips on Chrome 144+
openQuestions.detail: The supported branch builds the second P3 strip and its color-mix readout dynamically. On a 144+ build, confirm the strip renders, the readout serializes as color(display-p3-linear …), and the supported-note styling applies.

openQuestions.title: Consider a perceptual-space third strip
openQuestions.detail: §13.2 frames the choice as physical (linear), perceptual (oklab) or legacy (srgb). A future additive concept could put all three side by side as an interpolation-space chooser; out of scope for this page, which deliberately isolates the linear-vs-gamma contrast.

guidanceConsulted.query: wide gamut CSS colors and gamut fallbacks
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Prefer progressive enhancement for newer color features: feature-detect and keep the experience meaningful when a value is unavailable.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The page splits into a fully-working srgb/srgb-linear half and a feature-detected display-p3-linear half whose unsupported state is an explicit labelled panel reporting the actual CSS.supports results.

guidanceConsulted.query: range slider input accessible label live output value
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Style native range/checkbox controls with accent-color instead of replacing them with custom widgets.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The mix slider stays a native input[type=range] with accent-color: var(--accent-blue) and a visible value readout in its label; endpoints stay native input[type=color].

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible before after visual comparison sliders text equivalents
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Visual comparisons need text equivalents and live-region announcements, not color-only signalling.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The aria-live output narrates both computed midpoints numerically on every input change, and each gradient strip has an aria-labelledby description naming its interpolation space.

summary: The practical argument for the feature: srgb vs srgb-linear carries a real rendered proof on today's engine (verified: muddy rgb midpoint vs brighter linear midpoint, real computed serializations), and the new display-p3 vs display-p3-linear pair feature-detects and degrades honestly on pre-144 builds. A genuine [hidden]-override bug was caught and fixed during the 360px review.
